title: Large underground facility beneath the Pentagon processing USAP read-ons

tellings.quote: >> And then I under Washington DC, the Pentagon, I I have reason to believe there's a very large underground facility,

plain: Under Washington, DC, beneath the Pentagon, there may be a very large underground facility, says a researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb. As the story is filed, it is where people get read on, meaning formally briefed, into the military's most secret programs, the ones whose existence is never officially admitted. He says only that he has "reason to believe" this and names no source.
